definitions.short: by implication, to be acceptable ; also to succeed or prosper
definitions.full: H3787. kasher כָּשֵׁר verb be advantageous, proper, suitable, succeed , late Aramaic (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic כְּשָׁר , ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular הַמֶּלֶךְ לִפְנֵי הַדָּבָר וְכָשֵׁר Est 8:5 and the thing be proper in the view of the king; Imperfect יִכְשָׁר֨ Eccl 11:6 thou knowest not whether this shall succeed , or this. Hiph`il Infinitive construct חָכְמָה הַכְשֵׁיר וְיִתְרוֺן Eccl 10:10 an advantage for giving success is wisdom.
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root properly, to be straight or right;
